description: Source code for shared bot navigation functions, including map identification, configuration parsing, and navmesh header validation.

methods.name: GetNavgenMapId
methods.description: Determines map identification info based on the map's BSP file, using checksum or size.

methods.name: ParseOption
methods.description: Parses individual configuration options from a navgen config file.

methods.name: ReadNavgenConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses navgen configuration files for specific maps or defaults.

methods.name: GetNavmeshHeader
methods.description: Reads and validates the navmesh header from a file, ensuring compatibility with expected version and map.
